text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. The fixes in `catalog/` were:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying, so it now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice, so it now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third title. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my guess.
